title: On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks
contribution: Shows modern deep nets are overconfident and that single-parameter temperature scaling fixes most miscalibration post hoc

title: Beyond temperature scaling: Obtaining well-calibrated multiclass probabilities with Dirichlet calibration
contribution: Introduces Dirichlet calibration, a multiclass generalisation of beta calibration fitted post hoc on log-probabilities, with ODIR regularisation

title: Verified Uncertainty Calibration
contribution: Proposes scaling-binning calibrator with sample-efficiency bounds and shows plugin ECE estimates understate error of scaling methods

title: Distribution-free calibration guarantees for histogram binning without sample splitting
contribution: Proves distribution-free calibration guarantees for uniform-mass histogram binning without sample splitting

title: Calibration of Pre-trained Transformers
contribution: Measures in- and out-of-domain calibration of BERT and RoBERTa and shows temperature scaling reduces in-domain error

title: How Can We Know When Language Models Know? On the Calibration of Language Models for Question Answering
contribution: Finds T5, BART and GPT-2 QA probabilities are poorly calibrated and compares fine-tuning, temperature scaling and paraphrase fixes

title: Calibrate Before Use: Improving Few-Shot Performance of Language Models
contribution: Estimates prompt-induced label bias from a content-free input and applies an affine correction that stabilises few-shot ICL

title: Language Models (Mostly) Know What They Know
contribution: Shows large pretrained LMs are well calibrated on multiple-choice formats and trains a P(IK) head to predict whether the model knows an answer

title: Calibration of Encoder Decoder Models for Neural Machine Translation
contribution: Shows NMT token probabilities are miscalibrated, traces it to EOS and attention uncertainty, and recalibrates with these signals

title: On the Inference Calibration of Neural Machine Translation
contribution: Measures token-level calibration of NMT at inference and links miscalibration to translation errors

title: Analyzing Uncertainty in Neural Machine Translation
contribution: Analyses how NMT spreads too much probability mass over hypotheses and proposes tools to assess model calibration

title: Uncertainty Quantification with Pre-trained Language Models: A Large-Scale Empirical Analysis
contribution: Large-scale study of PLM choice, size, loss and post-hoc calibration for uncertainty quantification in NLP classifiers

title: A Close Look into the Calibration of Pre-trained Language Models
contribution: Tracks how PLM calibration evolves during fine-tuning and evaluates which learnable and post-hoc methods actually help

title: On the Calibration of Large Language Models and Alignment
contribution: Studies how pretraining and alignment stages (instruction tuning, RLHF) change LLM calibration of token probabilities

title: GPT-4 Technical Report
contribution: Reports that the pretrained GPT-4 base model is well calibrated on MMLU while post-training reduces calibration

title: Re-Examining Calibration: The Case of Question Answering
contribution: Argues ECE is misleading for QA calibration, proposes MacroCE and a consistency-based calibration method

title: On the Calibration of Massively Multilingual Language Models
contribution: Shows multilingual LMs are worse calibrated on low-resource and distant languages and tests temperature scaling and label smoothing

title: On the Effects of Transformer Size on In- and Out-of-Domain Calibration
contribution: Finds smaller PLMs calibrate as well in-domain, post-hoc calibration helps in-domain, and larger models calibrate better out-of-domain

title: Probabilities of Chat LLMs Are Miscalibrated but Still Predict Correctness on Multiple-Choice Q&A
contribution: Shows chat LLM answer probabilities are miscalibrated yet still rank correctness on multiple-choice QA

title: Calibration and Correctness of Language Models for Code
contribution: Builds a framework for evaluating calibration of confidence measures for generated code and tests Platt rescaling

title: My Answer is C: First-Token Probabilities Do Not Match Text Answers in Instruction-Tuned Language Models
contribution: Shows first-token option probabilities often disagree with the text answers of instruction-tuned LMs

title: On Hallucination and Predictive Uncertainty in Conditional Language Generation
contribution: Links token-level predictive uncertainty to hallucination in captioning and data-to-text generation

title: Calibrated Interpretation: Confidence Estimation in Semantic Parsing
contribution: Measures token-level calibration of semantic parsers across datasets and releases confidence-based challenge splits and a calibration library

title: A Study on the Calibration of In-context Learning
contribution: Finds ICL miscalibration peaks in low-shot settings, that fine-tuning and CoT can worsen it, and that scaling-binning recalibration helps

title: Large Language Models are Miscalibrated In-Context Learners
contribution: Finds LLMs are miscalibrated in low-resource ICL across learning methods and studies self-ensembling as a remedy

title: Language Model Probabilities are Not Calibrated in Numeric Contexts
contribution: Tests whether LM output probabilities match probabilities implied by numeric context and finds systematic biases

title: Investigating the Multilingual Calibration Effects of Language Model Instruction-Tuning
contribution: Shows instruction tuning on high-resource SFT data raises confidence without accuracy in low-resource languages

title: Large Language Models Are Overconfident in Their Own Responses
contribution: Separates post-training and chat-template effects on miscalibration and identifies an ownership bias toward self-generated answers

title: Calibration Across Layers: Understanding Calibration Evolution in LLMs
contribution: Traces calibration through network depth, finding a late-layer confidence-correction phase and a calibration direction

title: Confidence Regulation Neurons in Language Models
contribution: Identifies entropy and token-frequency neurons that regulate LM output confidence

title: Are You Sure You're Sure? On the Impact of Instruction Tuning on Confidence and Lexical Diversity
contribution: Compares base and instruction-tuned pairs, finding tuning raises confidence and degrades likelihood-based calibration

title: Discovering Latent Knowledge in Language Models Without Supervision
contribution: Finds a direction in activations that satisfies logical consistency (CCS) and recovers truth labels without supervision

title: The Internal State of an LLM Knows When It's Lying
contribution: Trains a classifier on hidden activations to predict statement truthfulness better than output probability

title: Do Androids Know They're Only Dreaming of Electric Sheep?
contribution: Probes internal states to detect hallucination in grounded generation at token and response level

title: The Curious Case of Hallucinatory (Un)answerability: Finding Truths in the Hidden States of Over-Confident Large Language Models
contribution: Shows hidden states encode whether a question is answerable even when the model answers anyway

title: Estimating Knowledge in Large Language Models Without Generating a Single Token
contribution: Predicts from the entity representation whether an LLM knows facts about it before generating any token

title: LLMs Know More Than They Show: On the Intrinsic Representation of LLM Hallucinations
contribution: Shows truthfulness signals concentrate in exact-answer tokens and that probe generalisation across tasks is limited

title: LLM Internal States Reveal Hallucination Risk Faced With a Query
contribution: Probes query internal states to estimate hallucination risk before a response is generated

title: Cognitive Dissonance: Why Do Language Model Outputs Disagree with Internal Representations of Truthfulness?
contribution: Explains query-probe disagreement largely by better probe calibration on uncertain inputs rather than deception

title: Diagnosing Correctness Probes under Self-Judgement Confounding
contribution: Shows correctness probes often decode the model's self-judgement rather than objective correctness

title: Factual Confidence of LLMs: on Reliability and Robustness of Current Estimators
contribution: Compares factual confidence estimators under a common protocol and finds trained hidden-state probes most reliable

title: Surface Form Competition: Why the Highest Probability Answer Isn't Always Right
contribution: Attributes zero-shot errors to surface form competition and rescores answers with domain-conditional PMI

title: Prototypical Calibration for Few-shot Learning of Language Models
contribution: Learns a decision boundary for zero- and few-shot ICL by fitting a Gaussian mixture over output distributions

title: Mitigating Label Biases for In-context Learning
contribution: Estimates label bias from random in-domain words and corrects ICL predictions with domain-context calibration

title: Batch Calibration: Rethinking Calibration for In-Context Learning and Prompt Engineering
contribution: Estimates contextual bias from the unlabeled test batch and removes it, unifying prior ICL calibration methods

title: Generative Calibration for In-context Learning
contribution: Adjusts ICL predictions by the label marginal estimated from Monte Carlo generations of the LM itself

title: Enhancing In-context Learning via Linear Probe Calibration
contribution: Fits a small linear calibrator on ICL output probabilities from a few labelled examples

title: Large Language Models Are Not Robust Multiple Choice Selectors
contribution: Diagnoses token-level option-ID bias in MCQ and removes it by estimating the prior on a few samples (PriDe)

title: Mitigating Word Bias in Zero-shot Prompt-based Classifiers
contribution: Reweights zero-shot label-word probabilities so the implied class prior matches a target, without labels

title: Beyond Performance: Quantifying and Mitigating Label Bias in LLMs
contribution: Quantifies label bias in LLM classification and proposes a few-shot calibration variant to mitigate it

title: Token-based Decision Criteria Are Suboptimal in In-context Learning
contribution: Replaces token-probability decisions with nearest-centroid classification on hidden states for ICL

title: Boosting In-Context Learning in LLMs Through the Lens of Classical Supervised Learning
contribution: Learns a per-class affine logit transformation from in-context data, generalising shift-only ICL calibrators

title: Thermometer: Towards Universal Calibration for Large Language Models
contribution: Trains an auxiliary model that predicts a task-level temperature for an LLM, transferring to unseen tasks

title: Calibrating Language Models with Adaptive Temperature Scaling
contribution: Predicts a per-token temperature from hidden features to restore calibration lost in RLHF

title: Your Pre-trained LLM is Secretly an Unsupervised Confidence Calibrator
contribution: Fits temperature of a post-trained LLM without labels by aligning to the base model on agreement examples (DACA)

title: Unlocking the Pre-Trained Model as a Dual-Alignment Calibrator for Post-Trained LLMs
contribution: Uses the pretrained model to correct both confidence drift and process drift in post-trained LLMs

title: Calibrating Large Language Models Using Their Generations Only
contribution: Trains an auxiliary model on question and answer text only to predict LLM confidence (APRICOT)

title: LitCab: Lightweight Language Model Calibration over Short- and Long-form Responses
contribution: Adds a single linear layer predicting a logit bias to calibrate LM outputs for short and long-form generation

title: Enhancing Language Model Factuality via Activation-Based Confidence Calibration and Guided Decoding
contribution: Trains a linear calibrator on activations and uses it to guide decoding toward factual answers (ActCab)

title: Uncertainty Estimation and Quantification for LLMs: A Simple Supervised Approach
contribution: Trains a supervised uncertainty estimator on hidden activations and output features at white, grey and black-box access

title: InternalInspector $I^2$: Robust Confidence Estimation in LLMs through Internal States
contribution: Uses contrastive learning over attention, feed-forward and activation states of all layers for confidence estimation

title: Calibrating LLM Confidence by Probing Perturbed Representation Stability
contribution: Perturbs final hidden states and trains a light classifier on stability features to predict correctness (CCPS)

title: Calibrating LLM Judges: Linear Probes for Fast and Reliable Uncertainty Estimation
contribution: Trains linear probes with a Brier loss on reasoning-judge hidden states for cheap calibrated judge uncertainty

title: Multicalibration for Confidence Scoring in LLMs
contribution: Applies multicalibration over embedding clusters and self-annotation groups to LLM confidence scores

title: On Calibration of LLM-based Guard Models for Reliable Content Moderation
contribution: Shows LLM guard models are miscalibrated and evaluates temperature scaling and contextual calibration for moderation

title: Knowing More About Questions Can Help: Improving Calibration in Question Answering
contribution: Trains a QA calibrator on question and evidence-context features with back-translation augmentation, beyond model confidence alone

title: Can Explanations Be Useful for Calibrating Black Box Models?
contribution: Uses attribution-based explanation features to train a calibrator for black-box NLP models under shift

title: Confidence Modeling for Neural Semantic Parsing
contribution: Trains a confidence model for neural semantic parsers from dropout-based and other uncertainty features and backpropagates uncertainty to input tokens

title: Calibration of Machine Reading Systems at Scale
contribution: Extends calibration methods to retriever-reader open-domain QA and claim verification by jointly calibrating pipeline components
